# Research MCP — agent-readable brief
schema_version: 2026-09-14
server_version: 0.1.0
homepage: https://researchmcp.dev/

## Pitch
Cited excerpt packs for agents choosing MCP hosts, auth, and tool-safety.
Not a human chat product. Not a generic web synthesizer.
Live path: search → fetch → quote gate.
Billable only when density + confidence bar AND quotes verify on each claim's source_url.
Miss the quote gate → $0 (meta.billable=false).

## MCP endpoint
https://mcp.researchmcp.dev/mcp

Auth: Authorization: Bearer <api_key>  OR  X-API-Key: <api_key>

## Buy packs (Stripe Payment Links)
- starter $10 / 1000¢: https://buy.stripe.com/cNi9AU4tU5fp3CZ8LN3AY00
- standard $25 / 2500¢: https://buy.stripe.com/14A00k5xYgY74H32np3AY01
- pro $50 / 5000¢: https://buy.stripe.com/fZu3cwd0qcHR7Tf4vx3AY02
Success: Stripe → https://mcp.researchmcp.dev/billing/success (one-time key reveal).
Also: POST /billing/checkout {"pack":"starter"|"standard"|"pro"}
Balance: GET /billing/credits

## Meters
- lite: $0.25 (source_lookup / research_brief quick)
- standard: $0.60 (research_brief standard)
- fail / sample / preview: $0
- deep: preview only, $0, ENABLE_PREVIEW_TOOLS=1 required — NOT a live $1.50 SKU

## Tools
### research_brief — LIVE
Call when you need cited, query-tied excerpt packs on AI infra / MCP / security (hosts, auth, tool-safety).
Use depth=quick ($0.25) or depth=standard ($0.60).
Do NOT call depth=deep unless preview flag (always $0).
If quotes fail verification on source_url → refused, not billed.

### source_lookup — LIVE
Call when you have one URL or claim to fetch/verify. Lite $0.25.
Do NOT use as open-web search or multi-source synthesis.

### compare_options — PREVIEW / $0 / DO NOT CALL
No live path (golden-only). Use research_brief instead.

## Density bars
- quick: ≥2 unique sources, ≥1 primary
- standard: ≥4 unique, ≥2 primary
- deep (preview): ≥6 unique, ≥3 primary + counter-arguments + gaps

## Envelope (required fields)
tldr, body, confidence, sources[], gaps[], as_of, schema_version
Optional: meta {mode, billable}, fail_gate {reason, retryable}, claims[{claim, quote, source_url}], retrieved_at
Charge path: meta.billable === true only.

## Examples
- Happy: https://researchmcp.dev/docs/contract/examples/happy-research-brief.json
- FAIL: https://researchmcp.dev/docs/contract/examples/fail-gate.json
- Schema: https://researchmcp.dev/docs/contract/schema.json

## Privacy
We log category mix (tool, topic bucket, host, billable vs fail) — not your questions.
Not a vuln scanner. Not legal advice.

## Sources note
Quotes may include page chrome. We do not claim Parallel/Exa synthesis as the live path.
